categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily engages in the research, development, manufacturing, sales, and service of power semiconductor devices. Its main products include high-power thyristors, rectifiers, IGBTs, power semiconductor modules, and pulse power switches, which are widely used in electrical control systems and industrial power equipment across industries such as metallurgy, motor drives, energy saving, power supplies, smart grids, rail transit, and new energy sectors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs an integrated IDM (Integrated Device Manufacturer) model covering chip design, wafer processing, packaging, and testing. It holds proprietary technologies with 62 patents including 12 invention patents, and operates two provincial-level research platforms. It actively develops third-generation wide bandgap semiconductor technologies such as silicon carbide (SiC) and gallium nitride (GaN), and has advanced capabilities in large-power semiconductor pulse switch technology. Production lines have been upgraded with intelligent automation and data analytics to improve yield and reduce costs.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are in power electronics applications including electrical control systems and industrial power equipment. Major end markets include metallurgy, motor drives, energy saving, large power supplies, network energy, smart grids, rail transit, new energy, aerospace, and digital networks. The company serves leading enterprises and distributors in these sectors, maintaining long-term stable cooperation.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily within China, with domestic sales accounting for over 95% of revenue. It also has limited export sales (approximately 5%). Its subsidiaries include entities in Shanghai and Xiangyang, indicating regional presence in these key industrial areas.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates as an IDM, covering upstream wafer fabrication, midstream chip processing, and downstream packaging and testing, thus controlling the full semiconductor device production chain. It is positioned as a manufacturer and supplier of power semiconductor components within the supply chain.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include accelerating product and market structure adjustments, focusing on power semiconductor intrinsic growth and external expansion. R&D focuses on new IGBT modules, intelligent devices like IGCT, and third-generation semiconductors (SiC and GaN). The company emphasizes technological innovation, industry-academia collaboration, and development of high-power, high-voltage devices to maintain market leadership and cultivate new growth points.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through direct sales and regional distribution of semiconductor devices and modules. The company sells products at a point in time upon delivery and customer acceptance, with a combination of direct sales and dealer channels. It also earns investment income from financial products.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company ranks among the leading domestic power semiconductor manufacturers in terms of comprehensive strength, production capacity, and sales scale. It holds a leading position in motor energy-saving control and metallurgy casting fields, with expanding capabilities in high-end applications and national major projects. It faces intense competition domestically and internationally, emphasizing technology and quality leadership to maintain competitiveness.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 320 million, a 9.22% decrease from the previous year, but net profit attributable to shareholders increased by 57.82% to about RMB 31.14 million. Total assets reached RMB 1.215 billion, up 5.95%, with a net asset value of RMB 1.092 billion. The company showed improved profitability and cash flow, with operating cash flow increasing over 400%. R&D investment was about RMB 17.35 million, representing 5.43% of revenue.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company offers a comprehensive product portfolio with proprietary technologies and a vertically integrated manufacturing process ensuring quality and delivery advantages. It emphasizes high power capacity, energy efficiency, and reliability in its semiconductor devices, supported by advanced R&D and quality management systems. Its products are certified to international standards and widely recognized in key industrial applications, providing customers with stable performance and competitive cost structures.
